mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We are experiencing clear skies and 80 degrees at Fireman's Park, though it feels closer to 88. Expect an overnight low of 72 degrees with no rain in the forecast. Under the third quarter moon, early risers can catch a glimpse of the Space Station at 4:19 AM, which will travel from Middleton and Verona High School in the northwest toward Fitchburg in the east, about halfway up the sky.

The City of Verona has welcomed a new public art piece, the Tai Chi Animal Frolics tree sculpture, now on display at Century School Park. Carved from a reclaimed ash tree by local artists Gene Delcourt and Christian Felland, and donated by Gerri Gurman, the seven-foot sculpture depicts animals from traditional Tai Chi. City staff plan to seek grants for native landscaping and multilingual signage in English, Ojibwemowin, and Mandarin to explain the movements and artists.

There are great activities happening today, including the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park, trivia at The Bogey Factory, and yoga at Insight Wellness. Looking ahead, Hop Haus is hosting trivia tomorrow, and you can catch live music this weekend at Bailey's Run Vineyard starting September 4th.
In police news, early Friday morning, a vehicle collided with a parked car on South Nine Mound Road, and the driver was cited for inattentive driving.

End your day on a sweet note! Culver's of Verona is currently open until 10 PM, serving up their delicious Oreo Reese's Cheesecake as the flavor of the day. Stop by before they close tonight to enjoy a scoop!
